description: This file provides utility functions to create mock runtime environment objects for testing purposes, including variants that simulate exit behaviors with or without throwing errors.

methods.name: export function createRuntimeEnv(options?: { throwOnExit?: boolean }): OutputRuntimeEnv { createRuntimeEnv
methods.description: Creates a mock runtime environment object with optional throwOnExit behavior, mocking log, error, writeStdout, writeJson, and exit functions.

methods.name: export function createTypedRuntimeEnv<TRuntime>(options?: { throwOnExit?: boolean }): TRuntime { createTypedRuntimeEnv
methods.description: Creates a typed version of the runtime environment by casting the generic environment returned by createRuntimeEnv.

methods.name: export function createNonExitingRuntimeEnv(): OutputRuntimeEnv { createNonExitingRuntimeEnv
methods.description: Creates a runtime environment that does not throw on exit, i.e., exit functions are mocked without throwing errors.

methods.name: export function createNonExitingTypedRuntimeEnv<TRuntime>(): TRuntime { createNonExitingTypedRuntimeEnv
methods.description: Creates a typed runtime environment that does not throw on exit.
